name.ja: HG 1/144 エグザベ専用ギャン(ハクジ装備)

description.ja: 『機動戦士Gundam GQuuuuuuX』(ジークアクス)より、「エグザベ専用ギャン（ハクジ装備）」をHGで立体化！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX " (Sieg Ax), " Exabe's exclusive Gyan (Hakuji equipment)" is made into a three-dimensional HG!

description.ja: • 肘の一軸関節やモノアイの可動を再現。
description.en: • Reproduces the movement of the elbow's uniaxial joint and mono-eye.

description.ja: • 巨大なスピア「ハクジ」が付属。
• シールドが付属し、ミサイルハッチ展開ギミックを再現。
description.en: • Comes with a seal to reproduce the missile hatch deployment gimmick.

description.ja: • ハクジ保持用の台座が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a pedestal for holding Hakuji.
